entities.name: Ceccardus of Luni
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Saint Ceccardus of Luni, otherwise San Ceccardo, was a bishop of Luni in Liguria, Italy, who was believed to have been killed by Vikings (Bjorn Ironside and Hastein, probably in 860 when they sacked the city of Luni.
